en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large two‑storey wooden building with a central gable and tiled roof, set at the end of a curved gravel driveway and framed by tall trees and hedges. The architecture looks like an early 20th‑century Nordic manor or community house. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner, and a small serial number is printed in the lower right.
